mutation_targets.rationale: removing this fact allows Member role to have PatchTaskById and DeleteTaskById permissions, which violates the least-privilege principle that only Admin should have these powers over non-owned tasks
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_BadPermissions { Member -> PatchTaskById in PermissionMatrix.allowed }

mutation_targets.rationale: removing the requirement that every task has a Created audit entry allows tasks to exist with no creation record, which violates audit completeness
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MissingCreatedEntry { some t: Task | no ae: AuditEntry | ae.task = t and ae.change_type = Created }

mutation_targets.rationale: removing the uniqueness constraint on (task, actor, change_type) allows duplicate audit entries, which violates the append-only invariant
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditDuplicate { some disj ae1, ae2: AuditEntry | ae1.task = ae2.task and ae1.actor = ae2.actor and ae1.change_type = ae2.change_type }

mutation_targets.rationale: removing the check that only owners and admins can modify tasks allows non-owner members to edit and delete tasks, violating access control
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NonOwnerEdit { some t: Task | some u: User | u != t.owner and (no tm: TeamMembership | tm.user = u and tm.team = t.team and tm.role = Admin) and (some ae: AuditEntry | ae.task = t and ae.actor = u and ae.change_type in (Modified + Deleted)) }

mutation_targets.rationale: removing the constraint that an assignee must be in the task's team allows cross-team assignment, which violates task integrity
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_BadAssignee { some t: Task | t.assignee != none and no tm: TeamMembership | tm.user = t.assignee and tm.team = t.team }

mutation_targets.rationale: removing uniqueness allows duplicate (user, team) memberships with inconsistent roles, breaking team context resolution
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DuplicateMembership { some disj tm1, tm2: TeamMembership | tm1.user = tm2.user and tm1.team = tm2.team and tm1.role != tm2.role }
